title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-23
content:
Morning sprint notes / quick backlog - Asha (2026-03-23)

Top priorities today:
- Finalize Hosted API PRD edits (v2) before EOD — incorporate SRE feedback on rate limiting and autoscale knobs.
- Sync w/ Miguel (11:00) for rollout plan + Dedicated capacity flags for canary.
- Follow up with Legal on data retention language for Private deploy package (email sent 3/21, awaiting POA).
- Pull together 1-pager for execs w/ latency & cost tradeoffs for model variants (quantized vs fp16).

PRD edits (things to check / TODOs):
- Intro: clarify target SLAs (95th pct latency targets) — add concrete numbers: 95th < 200ms for gen-small; 95th < 500ms for gen-large.
- Architecture: add short blurb on smart routing + automatic fallback (reference runtime routing doc).
- Autoscaling: include Miguel's suggested burst-to-dedicated policy + example config snippet (ask Miguel to paste).
- Telemetry: call out token-level cost breakdown and tracing tags (route_id, model_variant, customer_tier).
- Security: add KMS integration note and link to security-and-compliance checklist (doc id below).
- Open questions (to resolve before publish):
  * Should we expose "soft" batch_size hint to customers or keep internal only? pros/cons in notes section.
  * Do we need an explicit migration path for customers pinned to older model versions? (Sophie to advise)

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick):
- Miguel (infra) — ask for example burst policy + expected e2e latency impact (due 03/24).
- Sophie (SRE/ops) — confirm tracing tags and sampling strategy; confirm on-call escalation flow for degraded models.
- Priya (Sales) — need a one-pager with bullets on what Dedicated purchase gets customers (isolation, SLA, burst).
- Legal — ping on retention + data residency clause (remind: Private deploy package).

Launch checklist (brief, for Hosted API PRD rollout):
- [ ] PRD final review + sign-off (PM, SRE, Security)
- [ ] Add rollout plan to Console (canary percents, rollback criteria)
- [ ] Create Jira epic + sub-tasks for infra changes (PROD-4123 created)
- [ ] QA smoke tests for latency and correctness (include eval prompt-set)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards (latency, cost per token, error rate) — link: confluence/dashboards-hosted-api
- [ ] Customer communication draft for upcoming changes (announce quantization benefits + migration guide)

Meeting notes (from 09:30 sync with devs):
- Runtime team: kernel selection improvements landed on branch feature/kernel-opt-2026; needs integration test.
- Observability: added new trace fields, but sampling not yet tuned; Sophie will push proposal by Thu.
- UX/Console: canary rollout UI update planned next week; product ops to add API fields for rollout policy.

Quick draft email snippets (to copy):
- To Miguel: "Can you attach the example burst policy you mentioned and a short note on expected 95th latency change? Need to include in PRD before EOD 3/23."
- To Legal: "Following up on data retention language for Private. We need approved clause for PRD by 03/27 to meet launch timeline."

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider adding an "economics" appendix to PRD showing cost per 1M tokens for small/medium/large model variants across quantization settings. This helped Prod last quarter.
- Might be worth a short internal playbook for "degraded model" mitigation that product+SRE can run through during incidents.
- Keep PRD lean; move deep technical details to linked docs (runtime, autoscale config).

Unresolved items / next actions:
- Sophie to confirm sampling strategy (03/24) — blocker for telemetry section.
- Miguel to paste burst policy + perf numbers (03/24).
- Draft exec 1-pager (Asha) — circulate 03/24 morning.

Slack refs / tickets mentioned:
- slack:#prod-hosted-api thread: "rate-limit-fallback" (link in confluence notes)
- Jira: PROD-4123 (epic for hosted api rollout), PROD-4184 (autoscale infra task)

End of notes. Save copy to Confluence once edits look stable.

-- Asha
